coimbatore-2005.notes: Source 2 is one page with three tables (final round plus two preliminary-site lists); the detailed per-problem scoreboard (47 teams, A-H, attempts and Y/N) is inside source 1 as detailed-standings.htm and is not yet a source of its own.

sources.evidence: The seed page and the rules, schedule and dates pages name the 30th Annual ACM ICPC, Asia Region at Coimbatore, with the onsite contest on 11-12 December 2005 at Amrita University.
Table of the final round on 12/12/2005 with 47 teams, of which 42 carry a rank, citation, solved count and time and 5 are Honorable Mention; two further tables list preliminary-site teams.
Abstract standings page with a Top 10 table, a table of 32 further teams with solved and time, and a Participated list of 5 teams, headed Asia Region - Coimbatore.
Page headed SELECTED TEAMS with tables of team names, colleges or coaches and registration status for the Coimbatore contest.
PDF of 17 pages headed 30th Annual ACM ICPC, Asia Region, Coimbatore Site, 12th November 2005, with problems A to E.
PDF of 15 pages headed 30th ACM ICPC, Asia Region, Coimbatore Site, 11-12 Dec. 2005, with problems A to H.

coimbatore-2006.notes: The director's report says fifty teams came to Coimbatore while the standings list 51 (Amrita site) or 52 (final round table with one Honorable Mention). Source 6 is a report, not an editorial (roles corrected). Source 4 is a registered-team list, not standings (roles corrected). The Standings page in source 2 has no style sheet or images in our copy.

sources.evidence: The seed page is headed The 31st Annual ACM ICPC Asia Region - Coimbatore, and the schedule and dates pages give the onsite contest as 16-17 December 2006 at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham.
Table headed Final Standings with 51 team rows and yes or -- cells for problems A to G, no times or attempts.
Final Round table of 52 teams: 51 ranked rows with citation and solved count plus one Honorable Mention; three more tables for preliminary sites.
Page headed Registered Teams, stating that registration is closed, with 90 numbered rows of team name and institute and no results.
PDF of 15 pages headed 31st ACM ICPC, Asia Region, Coimbatore Site, 16-17 December 2006, with problems A to G.
One-page PDF titled Director's report, ICPC 2006, Asia-Coimbatore Site, an account of the contest by the regional contest director, not an explanation of solutions.
